name: Curse of the Hungering Blade (Lathspell Curse)
body:
The moment your hand touched the weapon, its fate became yours.

Bonus Spells: 0th—bleed, 1st—magic weapon, 2nd—greater magic weapon, 3rd—masochism/sadism, 4th—prismatic sword

Curse Manifestation: You are bound to a one-handed weapon of your choice, typically a sword, that hungers for the death of others seeking to bend you to bathe the weapon in blood. The presence of this malice grants you a +2 bonus on Intimidate checks and a -4 penalty on Diplomacy checks. Additionally, you are proficient only in the hungering blade and cannot gain proficiency in other weapons except by taking feats.

The hungering blade grows in power alongside you. It is treated as a masterwork weapon at 1st level and gains a +1 enhancement bonus at 4th level and every three levels thereafter to a maximum bonus of +5. Should the hungering blade be lost or destroyed, it reappears among your belongings in one hour’s time. If the blade has the broken condition, it is also removed after one hour.
